# executed by the failover controller, not read by a human
def failover(service):
    promote_standby_datastore(service)
    repoint_dns(service, ttl_seconds=30)
    scale_up(service.dr_region, to=service.full_capacity)
    verify_downstream_dependencies(service)   # from the dependency graph
    page_oncall(status="failover complete", service=service)
caption: The procedure is executable, tested, and ordered by the dependency graph — not a wiki page someone has to interpret under pressure.
